messages:
incident-bot: Pager: Elevated 5xx rate detected on /v1/generate (us-west-2). Alert triggered 22m ago. Errors: 502/504/timeouts. Affected model variant: t5-xl-q4_0.

oncall_jay: Ack — I'm on it. Any immediate customer impact?

alex_k: Seeing ~6% 502s across the gateway for hosted prod. Runtime logs show repeated segfaults from quant_attention.so in model-runner. Example snippet:```[segfault] signal 11 at 0x7f8c1a2b
backtrace:
  model_runner+0x4b2
  quant_attention.so+0x1f3a
  ...```

maria_s: Correlating with infra: yes, GPU eviction spikes preceded the segfaults. dmesg shows repeated OOMs on gpu0/gpu1:```[kernel] GPU OOM: freeing tensor 0x12f4
[watchdog] evicting 8 tensors from bdev-0
``` Sequence lengths trending up ~3x over baseline.

nicole_p: CS: We have 3 customers reporting timeouts in the last 15m (two enterprise evals, one PLG tenant). Notified support.

infra-ops: Confirmed: eviction storm on node pool infer-usw2-quant. Memory pressure + aggressive q4 allocation pattern causing fragmentation. Suggest immediate mitigation: divert traffic from q4 variant to a fallback (t5-xl-fp16) and spin up two extra unquantized runners.

oncall_jay: Proposed live plan: 1) Add routing override to divert 30-50% traffic from t5-xl-q4_0 to t5-xl-fp16 fallback, 2) Scale up unquantized runner group by +2, 3) Rolling restart of affected runners to clear kernel state, 4) Enable seq_len throttling for requests >2048. Who can apply the routing override?

alex_k: I'll push transient routing now. Command:```bash
curl -X POST https://internal-console/api/routing/override \
 -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","from":"t5-xl-q4_0","to":"t5-xl-fp16","percent":40}' \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"```

alex_k: Applied override — 40% traffic rerouted. Observability: 5xx dropped from 6% -> 1.5% within 4m. Latency for fallback is ~60ms higher p50.

maria_s: Kicking off rolling restart on infer-uw2-05 and infer-uw2-06 (drain -> restart -> join). Note: restarts may transiently increase tail latency.

infra-ops: Restarts completed on those two nodes. No segfaults emitted since restart on infer-uw2-05 (last 90s). Eviction rate lowered slightly but still elevated on several hosts.

nicole_p: Customer comms: sent workaround note to affected customers. Two asked for ETA — CS to escalate to account teams.

oncall_jay: Next: capture core dumps and traces for a fix. @alex_k upload core to artifact store and share link. Also let's enable throttling for seq_len > 2048 in routing policy (temporary).

alex_k: Core uploaded: https://artifacts.internal/9961234567/core-infer-uw2-05.tgz. Stack trace extract:```
#0  0x7f8c1a2b in quant_attention_compute
#1  0x55f3b1c in attention_loop
#2  0x4b201f in model_runner_main
``` Reproducer with local q4_0 profile using seq_len=4096 triggers assert in attention_loop.c: "idx < kv_len".

maria_s: Reproducer confirmed. Bug root cause looks like an index overflow when kv cache resizes under eviction; adding a bounds check prevents segfault but impacts performance. ML/runtime team recommends a small patch to quant kernel to harden the index and avoid use-after-free.

infra-ops: For now we pushed a throttling policy: requests with sequence_length > 2048 receive 429 with retry-after header. Also increased worker pool by +2 for unquantized runners.

oncall_jay: Severity set to Sev2 due to customer timeouts and multiple enterprise reports. Tracking ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RINF-3210. Keeping routing override in place for 2h or until error rate <1%.

nicole_p: CS: Customers acknowledged the temporary workaround; one wants a formal postmortem and ETA for a patch. We'll coordinate on the communication.

infra-ops: Next steps: ML runtime to prepare hotfix branch for quant_attention bounds checks + unit test for long sequences. We'll schedule canary rollout after hotfix.

oncall_jay: Good work team. I'll keep the channel open and update every 15m or on significant changes. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Update: last monitoring window shows error rate stabilizing at 0.9% (target <1%). Next automated check in 10m.
